_about: Deep-run content (Phase 2b): what unlocks at which level cleared, and the map modifiers. 'level' is levels cleared; the host can shift all of them with Unlocks/LevelShift. Effects are built into the mod by id; names, text and the modifier numbers can be changed here.

unlocks.name: Map modifiers: Heavy Haul, Infestation
unlocks.hint: Some levels roll a risk-and-reward modifier.

unlocks.name: Contract giver: The Auditor
unlocks.hint: High-stakes contracts: 1.5x pay, but a failure costs 15% of the reward.

unlocks.name: Elite type: Vampiric
unlocks.hint: Heals 20% of its max health whenever it hurts a player.

unlocks.name: Map modifiers: Thin Air, Fragile Goods
unlocks.hint: Two more modifiers join the roll.

unlocks.name: Shop section: Black Market
unlocks.hint: A Legendary, an Epic set piece and a module each visit, at 1.6x the price.

unlocks.name: Uniques: Final Notice, Repossessor, Night Shift Servos
Boss modifier: Warlord
unlocks.hint: Monsters within 12 m of the boss take 25% less damage.

unlocks.name: Twin bosses
unlocks.hint: Milestone levels have two named bosses, each with 70% of the health.

unlocks.name: Map modifiers: Elite Night, Skeleton Crew
unlocks.hint: Two more modifiers join the roll.

unlocks.name: Shop section: Contraband
unlocks.hint: Two cursed Legendaries each visit: an extra stat line and a permanent curse, at 1.2x the price.

unlocks.name: Uniques: Overtime Plating, Ledger of Debts, Danger Money
Elite type: Shielded
unlocks.hint: The first 25% of its health is a shield that comes back after 8 s without damage.

unlocks.name: Overtime
unlocks.hint: Every level rolls a map modifier, and two can stack.
